technique_name: Generate a data-driven analysis of the results of a survey.
description:
The survey data indicates that the majority of adults between the ages of 18 and 30 are primarily using mobile phones to call, with 59% of respondents indicating that they use their device to make a call. This indicates that traditional methods of communication such as making phone calls still remain popular among this demographic.

Texting follows closely behind in usage, with 21% of adults 18-30 reported using their device to text, indicating that this form of communication is also popular but
example: The survey asked 600 adults between the ages of 18 and 30 whether they use mobile phones to call, text, take pictures, browse the internet, etc. 59% reported that they use mobile phones to call, 21% reported that they use them to text, and 10% use them to take pictures.
